## Confirmed transformation
Input typically has a uniform background, one or more rectangular solid-color regions, plus scattered single-cell noise of a contrasting color. Some noise cells intrude into the solid regions; other noise speckles lie in the background. Output restores each solid patch to its uniform patch color and changes all exterior noise speckles to the background color. Preserve the patches' locations/dimensions and background.

For each visually solid rectangular patch, infer its color and fill the complete rectangle uniformly with that color, including any one-cell contaminations. Outside patch rectangles, recolor the sparse noise/marker cells to background. Do not preserve any exterior speckles.

## Demonstration evidence
Demo input 23x18 used background 3. Solid rectangles: color 0 at rows 0–5, columns 3–7; color 1 at rows 1–5, columns 12–17; and color 1 at rows 14–17, columns 3–9. The first two had colored noise cells in them; the bottom patch also had one 7 intruder. Outputs were complete uniform rectangles (0/1); all other non-background singletons (colors including 4,5,6,7,8) outside the patches became background 3.

## Solved test evidence
Test 11x26, background 6, had rectangular patches color 8 at rows 3–4, columns 15–21 and color 5 at rows 5–10, columns 6–11. Intrusions of color 4 within these patches were restored to patch colors: (r3,c16)→8; (r5,c9),(r8,c7),(r9,c11)→5 (zero-based). All other 4 cells outside the patches became background 6. Output accepted after an initial hypothesis that preserved exterior 4s and a repeat mistake that retained noise.

Some noise cells intrude into the solid regions; other noise speckles lie in the background. Output restores each solid patch to its uniform patch color and changes all exterior noise speckles to the background color. Preserve the patches' locations/dimensions and background.

For each visually solid rectangular patch, infer its color and fill the complete rectangle uniformly with that color, including any one-cell contaminations. Outside patch rectangles, recolor the sparse noise/marker cells to background. Do not preserve any exterior speckles.
